positive_result.construction: Append one t=361 factor to every row of the sealed D8 direct integer dual, preserving its coefficient.
positive_result.mathematical_scope: Exact characteristic-zero nonmembership of t^9 in the direct branch degree-9 ideal component only.

finite_extension_criterion.definition: E(lambda)(t*m)=lambda(m), and E(lambda)(m)=0 when t does not divide m. For a homogeneous generator g, C_k(g)=t^(-k) times the sum of terms of g divisible by t^k.
finite_extension_criterion.criterion: If lambda annihilates I_d and lambda(q*C_k(g))=0 for every generator, every k>=1, and every degree-compatible t-free monomial q, then E^n(lambda) annihilates I_(d+n) for all n>=0.
finite_extension_criterion.proof_split: For a degree-(d+n) column a*g, write a=t^r*q with t not dividing q. If r>=n, E^n pairing reduces to lambda((a/t^n)*g)=0. If r<n, it is lambda(q*C_(n-r)(g)); contractions beyond the generator t-valuation vanish.

all_degree_induction_result.reason: Every sealed D6, D7, and D8 certificate in all four branches fails at least one finite t-contraction equation.
all_degree_induction_result.direct_d8_detail: C_1 and C_3 are support-disjoint, explaining the one-step D8-to-D9 success, but C_2 has 58 failures and C_4 has 84 failures, so the same certificate cannot iterate to all degrees.
all_degree_induction_result.coloured_d8_detail: Each coloured D8 certificate already has 18 nonzero C_1 pairings across five literal generators; its one-t D9 transport therefore fails on exactly 18 literal columns.

support_stability.direct_d6_to_d7: Exact: all 10 rows are obtained by appending t and coefficients agree.
support_stability.direct_d7_to_d8: Not stable: only 4 transported rows match; 16 literal pairings fail.
support_stability.coloured_d6_to_d7: Not stable: only 4 transported rows match; 8 or 9 literal pairings fail.
support_stability.coloured_d7_to_d8: Not stable: only 4 transported rows match; 18 literal pairings fail.
support_stability.d8_structure: The three coloured D8 certificates each have 52 rows and contain the 38-row direct core plus a branch-specific 14-row carrier correction.
